summary: Over two episodes (about 3.7 minutes of play, 184 decisions by the decision model) the agent collected all 5 coins, pulled the lever, waved, read the sign, tried the closed door, walked around the end of the wall, went back and forth through the opened door, and reached the goal pad. The main bug: the wall can be walked around. The agent reached the goal pad and got "You win!" with 4 Coins while the door was still closed. Also, the sign is blank because its script errors on every start, and the door opens with one coin still left because one coin is worth 2. The lever and the HUD work as coded, but the lever changes nothing in the game, and the HUD never shows the coin count.
evidence: Episode 1 (trace1.jsonl), t=24.8-32.7: walk_around_wall_end took the agent past the end of the wall (the wall spans x ±1120 on a baseplate about 57,000 wide) with coins_stat 4 and the door closed (CanCollide true). At t=34.9-41.2, walk_onto_goal_pad set ReachedGoal and the HUD read "You win!" with Coins 4 and 2 coins still on the ground.

Episode 2 (trace2.jsonl), t=55-62: the door opened (CanCollide false, Transparency 0.8) when coins_stat reached 5, with coins_left 1. Coin3's Value of 2 means 4 coins open it. Coins ended at 6 with all coins taken.

Both episodes' game log, at start: [Error] Workspace.Sign.SignText:3: attempt to index nil with 'TextLabel'. A probe showed that /Workspace/Sign has no SurfaceGui child (only SignText). Episode 2's frames at game times 169-174 (describer): the sign's face is 'a plain pale grey-blue panel ... no text, colour patches or markings in any frame'.
Game log at start: [Warning] ContentId rbxassetid://203785492 failed: Asset type does not match requested type (x2).

Episode 2's frames at 181-188 (describer): the open doorway shows a 'pale, slightly see-through panel' between dark red sides, so the open door still looks like a solid panel. The HUD reads 'You win!' over the top of the view.
Episode 1 t=3.8-12: pull_lever (E at the prompt) set Pulled true and turned the Lever green (0.157, 0.784, 0.157). Nothing else in the game reacts to Pulled.

Wave (F) was pressed 4 times across both episodes, and in a probe both as F and as the 'Wave' action. The player attribute Waved was never readable. The client sets it locally, so it is not visible server-side. This is inconclusive, not a finding.
The HUD's Status stayed 'Collect the coins' from 0 to 4 Coins and changed only to 'You win!'. It never shows the coin count or that the door opened.
findings: The wall can be bypassed. It is only 2240 wide (x ±1120) on a huge baseplate. The agent walked around its end, stood on the GoalPad with 4 Coins and the door closed, and the game declared a win (ReachedGoal = true, HUD "You win!"). GoalPad's Touched handler never checks coins or whether the door is open (episode 1 t=24.8-41.2).

The sign is blank, and its script errors on every play test. Workspace.Sign.SignText:3 'attempt to index nil with TextLabel': the Sign has no SurfaceGui, so the 'Collect 5 coins to open the door' text never appears (game log; frames at 169-174 show a plain panel).

The door opens before all coins are taken. NEEDED = 5 is compared with the coin total, and Coin3 is worth 2, so 4 of the 5 coins open the door. The sign text intends 'Collect 5 coins' (episode 2 t=55-62: door open at Coins 5, coins_left 1).
The opened door is not removed or hidden, only made 0.8 transparent. It stays as a pale see-through panel in the doorway that the player walks through (frames at 181-188).
An asset fails to load at start: ContentId rbxassetid://203785492 'Asset type does not match requested type' (x2 warnings each play test).
The lever has no effect on the game. Pulling it toggles its Pulled attribute and colour, but no script reads Pulled (episode 1 t=3.8-12).
The HUD never shows progress. Status stays 'Collect the coins' through 0-4 Coins and the door opening, with no coin counter, and changes only to 'You win!' at the goal.
prompt: Explore the game for bugs: Go through the place and tell me everything that looks wrong (10 minutes of play)
